_comment: Machine-readable manifest of the three repos. `path` is relative to the fpl-orchestrator repo root (siblings = ../<repo>, self = .). The narrative companion is orchestration/MAP.md. Consumed by scripts/link-skills.sh, scripts/doctor.sh and scripts/dev.sh — edit here, not in the scripts.

repos.name: fpl-orchestrator
repos._branching_note: Planning repo: work is committed straight to main, never on a branch. A backlog entry, a plan or a decision that lives on an unmerged branch is invisible to the sessions that need it, and this repo exists to be read by the other two. scripts/doctor.sh and plugins/fpl/hooks/pre-bash-guard.sh both read this field — do not encode the rule in prose instead.

contracts.name: fpl-http-contract
contracts.notes: Every response is the ApiResponse<T> envelope. Types are generated into fpl-frontend/src/lib/api/types.gen.ts — never hand-written.

contracts.name: postgres-data-model
contracts.notes: Sole owner of the schema. No other repo talks to Postgres.

contracts.name: fpl-official-api
contracts.notes: Read endpoints are unauthenticated. Write endpoints (making a transfer, setting a lineup) need the user's own FPL session cookie — not built yet, see MAP.md.
